title: Cryptocurrency market structure by economic functionality
introduction: A whole-market view of how four economic functions divide the cryptocurrency universe by market value, token count, and active-address dynamics.
insights: General Payment and Platform tokens account for 98.7% of observed market value.
Platform tokens represent 86.0% of the classified token universe by count.
The four activity paths reveal distinct category life cycles from 2018 to 2024.
